OFFER TO EXCHANGE
Each Outstanding Share of Common Stock of
LARKSPUR HOLDING COMPANY
for 1.35 Newly Issued Class A Ordinary Shares of Larkspur Global plc

The exchange offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on November 20, 2026, unless extended.

Larkspur Global plc is offering to exchange each outstanding share of common stock of Larkspur Holding Company for 1.35 newly issued Class A ordinary shares. No cash consideration will be paid in the exchange offer, other than cash in lieu of fractional shares.

Odd Lots. Holders who own beneficially or of record fewer than 100 shares and who tender all of those shares will have their shares accepted for exchange before proration, if any, of the shares tendered by other holders.
